# Microsoft Edge WebView2 SDK

Pinned package: Microsoft.Web.WebView2 1.0.3405.78 from NuGet.
SHA256: d035807b2aaba871e8c014759626f566e96934e6ce6f0587056ee81d5228c373

Build downloads and verifies the SDK into work, then embeds its managed SDK
assemblies and x86/x64 loader in NezhaPet.exe. The Microsoft WebView2 Runtime
is a separate installed runtime dependency. LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt apply.
